articles.summary: Opentrons Robotics Network Infrastructure Becoming Core for AI-Driven Drug Discovery NEW YORK, January 29, 2026 — Opentrons Labworks, Inc., a laboratory robotics company building the physical infrastructure for AI-driven drug discovery, today announced the promotion of James Atwood to Chief Executive Officer.
